description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationDao class responsible for managing EmployeeEducation entities, including saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching education records related to employees within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for EmployeeEducation entities, handling database operations such as save, retrieve, delete, and search with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEducation entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeEducation record by employee number and education record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmpEducationIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns IDs of EmployeeEducation records that exist for a given employee and list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEducations
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeEducation records for a given employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Performs a paginated search for EmployeeEducation records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for searching EmployeeEducation records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeEducation records matching search filter parameters.
